title: Seiche Audited Direct-OFR Time Series
subtitle: Draft repo and money-fund observations sourced directly from OFR
description: DRAFT - NOT SUBMITTED. NO DOI ASSIGNED. A rights-reviewed snapshot of 11,163 observations from ten Office of Financial Research series: six repo-market series and four money-market-fund series. The staged files reference only the audited direct-OFR Data Commons candidate CSVs. FRED-fetched values, runtime caches, New York Fed reference-rate rows, the mismatched primary-dealer row, licensed series, and Seiche-derived outputs are excluded. Observation dates retain the publishers' native daily or monthly clocks. Research data, not investment advice. Source credit: United States Office of Financial Research.
